Asha (CS): Quick note 14: were seeing intermittent auth latency affecting a small set of onboarding tenants in EU (~10-15 accounts). Need an immediate customer ack + office hours. Marcus, status?

Marcus (Eng Oncall): Patch rolled to canary 8m ago, canary p95 dropped ~55%. Rolling to EU clusters now. Root cause looks like auth-cache TTL change causing cache churn.

Asha (CS): Draft ack for customers (short): 

"Hi <CustomerName>, were investigating intermittent auth latency in EU affecting some onboarding flows. Engineers are deploying a mitigation now; you may see slower sign-in or provisioning for up to ~2 hours. Quick try: retry once or restart the client. Office hours: 14:00 UTC (join link). Well follow up with an RCA. Reply here for prioritized help.  Asha, CS"

Priya (CS Ops): Segment outbound: SMB/onboarders = broadcast + office hours; enterprise = personalized note + phone. Ill prepare lists and send in ~10m. Include goodwill credit option for high-touch accounts.

Julian (SE): Add status page link and support snippet: `If issues persist, capture timestamp + request-id and include when you reply.` Status: https://status.redwood.example/INC-2026-042

Raj (Product): For RCA capture timeline, root cause (auth-cache TTL), impacted accounts, mitigation steps, and prevention (canary gating + auth-retry alerting).

Incident Bot: INC-2026-042 created  status: mitigation in progress (canary green, EU rollout). Pager: @marcus.

Marcus (Eng Oncall): EU rollout finished +28m after canary. p95 returned to baseline. Will upload metrics and logs to the RCA doc.

Asha (CS): Thanks team. Priya -> send segmented outreach now. Ill host office hours and collect customer feedback for exec notes. :thumbsup:
